paragraphs: Tom has a busy week. On Monday after school, he plays football with Ben. Ben is quick, and Tom is strong. Lily and Pip watch the game. On Tuesday, he does his homework before dinner. He is tired, but he always does it well. On Wednesday, he has piano practice at five o'clock. "Piano is difficult," says Tom. "Do you practice often?" asks Lily. "Yes, I practice every day," says Tom.

On Thursday, there is rain, so Tom is at home with Pip. They read a book on the sofa. On Friday, Tom plays the guitar in the school band. The band practices after school in the library. The music is very loud. "Is it loud?" asks Lily. "Yes, it is!" says Tom. "But I like it."

On Saturday, the family has a picnic near the lake. Mom has sandwiches and fruit. Lily and Pip run on the grass. Dad takes a photo of them. Pip is always hungry at a picnic. On Sunday, the family watches a film at home. Tom is very tired now. Pip sits on Tom's feet. "It is a good weekend," says Tom. "I like a busy week!"
text.summary: Tom has a busy week with football, piano, homework, and a school band. At the weekend, the family has a picnic and watches a film.
